extracted.name: Peach Bellini
extracted.description: Peach Bellini is a deliciously refreshing fruity cocktail that's easy to make with just two ingredients: pureed peaches and chilled Prosecco.
instruction_lines: Pour peach puree into a fluted glass; top with Prosecco or Champagne.
Garnish with a slice of peach. Enjoy!
